privacy.title: Privacy information
privacy.subtitle: How your information is kept private, safe, and entirely yours.
privacy.noAccountDesc: Sakhi works completely without logins, passwords, emails, or phone numbers. Your identity is never requested.
privacy.onDeviceDesc: All your cycle dates, personal notes, and reading history stay exclusively on this device inside a local database.
privacy.noSharingDesc: Nothing is ever sent to servers, trackers, or third parties. Sakhi operates 100% offline without network connections.
privacy.appDeletionDesc: Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored data from this phone, subject to your device's automatic cloud backup settings.
